evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is not in a straight line and increased signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.
evidence.MCL: Grade 2 injury of MCL (especially at the deep MCL/meniscofemoral ligament).
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in the body and posterior horn of medial meniscus with extension to the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: suspect posterior root tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: Bone contusion in distal femur, proximal tibia and fibula, and lower pole of patella.
evidence.Fracture: Subchondral fracture over posterior aspect of medial tibial plateau
